content.title: Where To Watch The Warriors
content.text: It goes without saying that the Golden State Warriors have spent this season tearing up the court. Things are hotter than ever and if you're anything like us, you'd rather root for our boys in blue with fellow fans and plenty of beer than watch from the couch solo-style. Thankfully, the Bay loves to get together, drink, party, and cheer, so we rounded up the best spots to catch all the plays in real time. San Francisco Monarch Gardens(428 11th St. // SoMa, Formerly District Six)This spot isn't just the ultimate food truck destination. It also hosts massive playoff viewing parties. With ten big screen TVs, drink specials, and your pick of the lot when it comes to eats, it doesn't get much better than this. Hi Tops(2247 Market St // Castro)The Castro's premier gay sports bar is a great spot to catch the game and some eye candy. You can't go wrong with their pitchers of beer, hi-res big screens, or their awesome menu of nachos, soft pretzels, and one crazy delicious fried chicken sandwich. Golden Gate Taproom(525 Sutter at Powell St // Downtown) Sure, it's touristy, but you can go all out with the plethora of screens and brews available at this spacious spot. Entertain yourself during commercial breaks with games like shuffleboard, SkeeBall, Foosball, arcade games, and pool. San Francisco Athletic Club(1750 Divisadero St // Lower Pac Heights)You can't go wrong at this city staple for watching sports. Show up early to secure the best view and order their famous bathtub of beer. What can we say? This place is a rowdy favorite!Curio(775 Valencia St // Mission)With multiple screens, great cocktails, and tons of food & drink specials (including an assorted wing platter with hella flavors – yum), Curio doesn't miss when it comes to setting you up right for game day.Thrive City at Chase Center(1725 3rd St // Mission Bay)While they don't host watch parties for every game, the ones they do throw are always a good time. RSVP for free admission and enjoy lawn games, food, entertainment, and more while the games go down. See their upcoming schedule here. East Bay Mad Oak(135 12th St // Oakland)This spacious, popular spot is a great option for viewing the game with a bunch of friends (or making new ones!). They've got plenty of tables for you to watch the game, awesome cocktails, and plenty of craft beer on tap. Oh yeah, they also have a citrus press, so those Palomas are as fresh as they can get.Heads & Tails Barbecue(2121 San Pablo Ave // Berkeley)Post up with your pals at this neighborhood bbq spot with a full bar. If there's a game on, they're definitely screening it! Grab some of their Tex-Mex inspired cuisine to fuel up so you can cheer the Dubs on. George & Walt's(5445 College Ave // Oakland)If you're looking for that straightforward, no-frills sports bar, George & Walt's is for you. We like the local favorite's super affordable brews. Bobby G's Pizzeria(2072 University Ave // Berkeley)Get down in low-key digs at Bobby G's, where you can sip a beer and chow down on 'za to your heart's content while watching the Dubs dominate. Cafe Rack(5768 Peladeau St // Emeryville)A sports bar through and through, you can shoot a game of pool while watching the Warriors at this Emeryville joint. Classic bar bites and beers should go without saying, but just in case it doesn't, they've got those, too. South Bay + Peninsula Wursthall(310 Baldwin Ave // San Mateo)This German-inspired beer hall is a great place to settle in for beers and brats. Order a liter of lager and pick a spot at one of the long communal tables to watch the game unfold. Bert's Stadium Sports Bar(208 S Fair Oaks Ave // Sunnyvale)There's a TV every which way you look at this increasingly popular sports destination with pool tables and plenty of classic pub grub. O'Malley's Sports Pub(2135 Old Middlefield Way // Mountain View) Sometimes you can't beat an Irish sports pub. This one definitely delivers. Solid bartenders and a cozy but spacious setting = a great place to catch the game. Taplands(1171 Homestead Rd // Santa Clara)A wide array of craft beer on tap is the major selling point here. Score a seat at the bar to watch the game.Stuft Pizza(Santa Clara // Milpitas)Bomb pizza. Hella TV screens. What more could you want? Beer? You got it. IBU Taproom is right next door. North Bay Flatiron(724 B St // San Rafael)This place is known for their wings, so grab a dozen or two and settle in for some basketball, baby. Modern yet woodsy digs and a full bar are the cherries on top at this sweet spot. NapaSport(145 Gasser Dr Ste A // Napa)A more upscale option with a full steakhouse menu, you can catch the game at NapaSport while lounging on a leather couch, drink in hand.Ausiello's 5th Street Bar & Grill(609 5th St // Santa Rosa)Ausiello's is a friendly neighborhood bar and grill that always has a game on, and during playoffs, that means the Warriors are guaranteed to be on the big screen. Pig in a Pickle(341 Corte Madera Town Ctr // Corte Madera)It's not the biggest place in town, but if you can score a spot at the bar you'll have a perfect TV view. Barbecue smoked in house doesn't hurt, either. Written by Alex Killian Do a little gaming of your own with our guide to Bars and Restaurants with Games!
